card.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
card.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You told the trainees their head trainer was an idiot. I want an apology.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For undermining their head trainer. They still need to follow my instructions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll email them after tomorrow's drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read it to them before the drill. My whistle isn't going to outrank 'idiot' on its own.

mechanism: A demands an apology that restores the head trainer's authority over trainees before it is needed again.
confusable: Unlike correcting a failed drill, A must target the disrespect to position and its effect on obedience.
comparison: D51-b changes apology audience and timing; D51-a changes personal you to the formal chair title.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
